result.summary: The image shows a narrow one-way street with a very constrained pedestrian environment. A narrow sidewalk exists on the left side but is obstructed by bollards, while the right side is bordered by a chain-link fence with no dedicated walkway.

hazards.name: Narrow and Obstructed Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the left is extremely narrow and further restricted by the placement of bollards, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no paved sidewalk on the right side of the street, which is bordered by a chain-link fence.

hazards.name: Blank Frontage
hazards.description: The long chain-link fence creates a blank frontage that reduces the sense of safety and comfort for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk on the left to meet ADA standards and relocate bollards to the curb edge or remove them if not necessary for structural protection.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a continuous and safe path for pedestrians on both sides.

interventions.title: Street Greening
interventions.description: Introduce street trees or planters where space permits to improve the pedestrian experience and provide a buffer from the roadway.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, paved sidewalk running alongside a fenced school yard and a large institutional building. The environment is characterized by a continuous walkway but lacks a physical buffer between pedestrians and the adjacent roadway, which is obscured by image blurring.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the curb with no planting strip or furniture zone to separate pedestrians from moving traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, along the edge of the blurred roadway area

hazards.name: Sterile Frontage
hazards.description: The long chain-link fence creates a blank street edge that lacks active engagement and natural surveillance.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the sidewalk, extending along the property line

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Install a planting strip with street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide a physical buffer and improve the microclimate.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting fixtures along the sidewalk to improve visibility and safety, especially given the long fenced frontage.

result.summary: The image depicts a narrow urban street or alleyway that lacks dedicated pedestrian sidewalks, forcing people to share the roadway with vehicles. The environment is constrained by a large institutional building on one side and a chain-link fence on the other, with no visible traffic calming or crossing infrastructure.

hazards.name: Lack of separated sidewalk
hazards.description: Pedestrians must walk in the travel lane, creating a high risk of conflict with motor vehicles in a narrow space.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire length of the visible street

hazards.name: Narrow shared roadway
hazards.description: The constrained width of the street leaves little room for pedestrians to safely move aside if a vehicle passes.

interventions.title: Shared Street (Woonerf) Treatment
interventions.description: Redesign the street with textured paving, signage, and landscaping to clearly indicate a pedestrian-priority zone where vehicles must move at walking speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add more frequent, lower-height lighting to improve visibility and security for pedestrians using the narrow corridor at night.

interventions.title: Wayfinding and Safety Signage
interventions.description: Install signs alerting drivers to the presence of pedestrians and designating the area as a slow-speed zone.

result.summary: The image shows a very narrow pedestrian walkway immediately adjacent to a building facade. The path is obstructed by a set of stairs and a metal post, providing minimal space for safe pedestrian movement and no separation from the roadway.
